name: A NAIL
note: EXTRACTED from docs/121-the-not-done-list.md (THE LINES) by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 250). Do not edit: change doc 121 and re-run. One nail from the mercantile's keg. With it the letter of introduction is fixed to Pike's board; it leaves with the letter.
iconPending: reference/objects-second-pass/brief.md asks the image session for it (errata 250); the panel draws its labelled box meanwhile.

LOOK_AT.say: One nail, out of a keg of every size mixed. I have no idea which size it is. Neither had the keg.
repeat: It is on my account at the mercantile, under EGGS and TONIC. My debts are becoming a household.
A nail wants a board and a reason. I have been carrying it about until it found both.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. It expects to be hit, like most of us here.
repeat: A thin note against the tuning fork. Iron, and sharp with it.
Nothing. One nail does not rattle. It takes company for that.
